subject.en: Red-capped trainer turning with a Poké Ball
subject.zh: 红帽少年回头举起精灵球

tagline: A small pocket. A whole adventure.
context: GB / GBC / GBA collection with browser play and local saves.
body: Reinterpret the trainer in reference image 1 as a refined, connected-facet character portrait for Poké Pocket. Keep the red cap with its white brim and dark round ball emblem, dark tousled hair, red-and-ivory jacket, natural confident smile, and the friendly backward glance while holding a red-and-white Poké Ball close beside the face. This is a character portrait, not an animal and not a realistic human photograph. Capture the decisive instant just before an adventure: eyes clearly meet the viewer, the raised ball is the single secondary focal point. Use broad, crisp, connected polygonal color planes, nuanced sculptural volume and a restrained red, charcoal and warm ivory palette. Do not copy the thick black outlines of the reference. The ball supplies the focused bright accent; do not add rainbow face paint, confetti, extra balls or other accessories. Keep the head, cap, hair and complete raised hand large and legible, with generous room around their perimeter. An 85 mm portrait-viewfinder analogy guides the natural turn and relative scale; let the model choose the best camera and anatomy. Show just the shoulders needed to explain the gesture, entering naturally through the lower middle edge of the canvas, with the rest of the body outside the view. No closed-off circular bust or cropped cap/ball/fingers. Keep the surrounding field entirely uniform white, with no frame, shadows outside the character, background texture, text or watermark. Reference 2 defines the connected faceted drawing language, while references 3 and 4 define only the eventual tactile, offset presentation, which will be added separately. The supplied trainer image is the identity and pose reference, not a layout to trace rigidly.

subject.en: Titanium F-22 desk model caught in a banking turn
subject.zh: 掠过镜头的钛灰 F-22 模型

tagline: A banking turn, held in metal.
context: Browser arcade air combat: fly an F-22 against Su-35s.
body: One exceptional die-cast F-22 stealth fighter desk model, caught in the quiet decisive instant of a shallow banking turn. Its broad diamond wings, twin canted tail fins and compact pointed fuselage should form a bold coherent mark. Use honest satin titanium, subtle blue-gray ceramic-coated panels, finely machined panel joins and a single warm amber smoked canopy. This is a collectible physical aircraft model, with convincing thickness and restrained material detail; no missiles firing, vapor trails, sky scene, pedestal, jet plume, labels or detached parts. A 70 mm product view from a three-quarter front/top angle, around 30 degrees elevation, should keep the entire wingspan, nose and both tail fins visible. Let the model select an expressive diagonal and an elegant slight bank. The substantial wings carry the icon, not an extremely thin side-on fuselage. Keep every tip complete within the white viewfinder.

description.en: A broad-winged F-22 collectible banks diagonally toward the viewer. A gentle elevated product camera preserves the nose, both tail fins and the complete wing silhouette.

description.en: Satin titanium and blue-gray panel faces define a real die-cast object. The amber canopy is the single warm material accent; there are no detached trails or effects.

subject.en: Walnut and brass prairie arcade joystick
subject.zh: 胡桃木与黄铜的西部街机摇杆

tagline: A little arcade, with a prairie soul.
context: A browser prairie shooter inspired by Journey of the Prairie King.
body: A beautifully made miniature western arcade control box, one cohesive physical object. A compact warm walnut housing with rounded corners, a dark aged-brass control plate, one bold oxblood-red ball-top joystick and a small grouped pair of ochre and muted teal buttons. Subtle engraved prairie sun rays in the brass give the object its western character without words or decorative clutter. Capture the joystick just leaning into a move, as a decisive tactile instant; no human hand. The wood grain, softened brass edges, real fasteners and satin lacquer should feel lovingly crafted, with a readable joystick silhouette at small size. A 65 mm product perspective around 35 degrees above the object shows its top and one thick side. Let the image choose the exact rotation and proportions. No screen, full arcade cabinet, cables running out of frame, pixel art, floating bullets or extra props.

description.en: Real wood grain and engraved aged brass give the prairie shooter a handmade arcade identity. The deep-red joystick leads, supported by one close ochre-and-teal button group.

context: Developer and Git repository activity analytics, collected locally and displayed in a web dashboard.
body: One premium hand-held mechanical tally counter, celebrating the act of making developer activity visible. A compact rounded petrol-blue enamel metal body, brushed brass thumb plunger and a small recessed mechanical number window with ivory digit drums. A short polished finger loop nestles close to the body so the whole assembly reads as one compact object. Capture the thumb plunger just beginning to return after a count, with one digit drum fractionally turning. The number wheels can show a simple short count, but no branding or large text. Make the physical mechanism tactile, believable and sophisticated: restrained enamel reflections, precision seams, softened metal edges. A 75 mm three-quarter product view at around 30 degrees elevation keeps the main counter mass dominant and the plunger clearly readable. This project measures developer/repository activity, not document signing; no pen, wax seal or signature.

subject.en: An opened green enamel and brass padlock
subject.zh: 刚刚开启的绿珐琅黄铜挂锁

tagline: The latch lifts. The app is yours.
context: A macOS CLI that scans app quarantine flags and removes selected restrictions.
body: One exceptionally crafted opened padlock, its sturdy brass shackle lifting freely from a deep sage-green enamel body. Capture that small decisive instant just after release: the shackle is visibly open and slightly turned, while the compact main body remains calm and substantial. A small torn vermilion paper seal stays attached to the side as one restrained physical accent, not a flying ribbon. Real brushed brass, gently worn enamel edges and fine chamfers make a believable premium object. No key, letters, checkmark badge, hands, chain or extra props. A 75 mm three-quarter close product view around 25 degrees elevation makes the opening unmistakable, with the complete shackle, paper tab and body within the viewfinder.

subject.en: Celadon mechanical keycap with a Chinese character
subject.zh: 带汉字的青瓷机械键帽

context: A Chinese pinyin input engine with language-model decoding and streaming prediction.
body: One elegant mechanical keyboard key, a substantial rounded celadon-green ceramic keycap with the single carefully formed Chinese character 中 inset in warm ivory on its top. A small portion of the dark switch housing and copper spring is visible beneath the cap, explaining its physical action without an exploded diagram. Capture the key rebounding very slightly after a press, the cap and mechanism still one close coherent object. The glazed ceramic should have rich restrained micro-reflections and subtly mottled celadon depth, with clean bevels and precise tiny metal details. No whole keyboard, hands, floating glyphs, decorative calligraphy or other words. A 70 mm product lens around 35 degrees elevation sees the character and two side faces. Let the model choose the charming tilt and physical proportions; the rounded key mass must remain legible at favicon size.

context: A local debate board where AI coding agents exchange proposals and a human sets checkpoints.
body: One finely crafted analog chess clock with two ivory circular faces set in a single compact curved walnut case. Small dark hands and subtle tick marks form readable opposing dials; use no numerals or lettering. Two short satin-brass plungers sit on top, one down and the other just raised, capturing the decisive instant when a discussion changes sides. A narrow oxblood edge detail supplies one restrained color accent. The visible grain, hand-finished edges, glass dial reflections and credible clock thickness should feel like a beautiful real instrument. A 75 mm view at roughly 20 degrees elevation and a modest three-quarter rotation preserves the paired-face symmetry without becoming perfectly frontal. No chess pieces, game board, stage or detached props.

subject.en: A brass and navy pocket compass
subject.zh: 黄铜与深蓝的袖珍罗盘

tagline: A precise little sense of place.
context: An API-only IP geolocation service combining multiple location databases.
body: One exquisite pocket surveying compass, a chunky circular brushed-brass case with a midnight-navy dial, a clear but optically restrained glass face, and a single vivid red-and-ivory compass needle caught settling toward north. Fine bearing ticks and a quietly embossed compass rose give truthful instrument detail without readable labels. A small folded hanging ring and the slightly raised hinge sit close to the substantial case, never forming a distant accessory. Keep it a tangible precision tool with believable metal thickness and gently softened edges, not a flat app glyph or floating map pin. Use a 75 mm three-quarter product perspective about 35 degrees above, allowing the image to choose the most legible dial angle. No map, pedestal, chain, glow outside the object or extra props.

subject.en: A midnight teal rotary desk telephone
subject.zh: 午夜青色旋转拨号电话

context: A local-first macOS AI gateway connecting Discord, the terminal and HTTP.
body: One beautifully restored rotary desk telephone, in deep midnight-teal Bakelite with a warm ivory rotary dial and discreet brass hardware. The receiver rests slightly diagonally on its cradle, as if a conversation has just ended, while a short coiled cord curls closely beside the body as one coherent gesture. Capture that familiar tactile decisive instant; no hand or separate handset floating far away. Give the Bakelite rich fine surface grain, soft broad reflections, gentle age at contact edges and convincing physical weight. Keep the phone compact and broad, with clear receiver ends and a substantial curved base. A 70 mm product perspective about 30 degrees elevated sees the dial and the whole receiver. No lettering, digital screen, plug cut off by the frame, extra speech bubbles or background furniture.

tagline: Set the moment. Let it run.
context: A declarative macOS scheduler that runs AI jobs through launchd.
body: One premium mechanical stopwatch, an emerald-green enamel dial inside a smoothly machined satin steel case, with a warm brass winding crown and a single short start button. A fine ivory timing hand has just begun to sweep, held sharply in one decisive instant, with no motion blur. Subtle ivory minute ticks and one small inset subdial communicate a real timing instrument without labels or excessive numerals. Give the enamel physical depth, the steel a soft brushed finish and the glass a controlled highlight that never hides the hand. A 75 mm close product perspective about 25 degrees above the face keeps the round body dominant, with the complete crown and button inside the frame. No chain, watch strap, calendar, running person, extra props or external glow.

subject.en: A folded newspaper in a forest-green reading folio
subject.zh: 森林绿阅读夹中的折叠报纸

tagline: The world, gathered for a quiet read.
context: A self-hosted RSS reader with AI summaries and translation.
body: One handsome compact reading folio: a forest-green textured leather cover holding a folded warm-ivory newspaper, with several layered paper corners visible and one small copper clip securing the upper edge. The slightly opening paper catches the decisive instant before reading. Use fine leather grain, dense opaque cream paper with softly visible fibers, crisp but natural folds, and a beautifully rounded brushed-copper clip. The newspaper should use tasteful abstract gray headline rules, column lines and one muted image block, not gibberish lettering, logos or legible article text. This is one coherent held-together object, not a full book scene. A 70 mm three-quarter view around 35 degrees elevation gives the folded pages and folio a rich compact silhouette. Keep every page corner and the complete clip within generous margins; no flying sheets, hand, cup or reading glasses.

subject.en: A green network cable tester with a short patch lead
subject.zh: 带短跳线的绿色网线测试仪

tagline: A good connection, before the next command.
context: A CLI that checks a network condition before allowing a command to execute.
body: One compact professional Ethernet cable tester with a deep-green rubber bumper and a brushed charcoal-metal face. A short cream patch cable loops neatly from the top back to a neighboring port, with believable translucent smoky RJ45 connector housings. Keep that cable loop close and broad enough to read as one small attached gesture, while the sturdy rectangular instrument remains primary. Three small green indicator lamps are solid luminous surfaces, showing a good connection; no exterior glow and no readable labels or numbers. Capture the calm instant when the test has passed. Fine metal machining, real molded rubber seams and cable texture should make it a high-quality tangible object. A 70 mm product perspective roughly 30 degrees elevated should show the face, top ports and complete compact cable loop. No padlock, shield glyph, monitor, hand, long trailing wire or extra props.
